about: Components of Dev-Kit, in install order (docs/app/CATALOG.md). key: file (or non-empty folder) that shows the component is installed, relative to data/apps/<target> (win32-x64, darwin-arm64...), written with the Windows names and translated for macOS and Linux (setup/catalog.rs translate_rel); '@' = relative to the kit root. keys: its other parts (Maven, Ninja, Composer...), same rules as key: the component is installed only when the key and all of them exist. folder: what the component owns in data/apps/<target> (removed when the component is turned off). x64Only: no Windows ARM64 build, the x64 one runs there in emulation. rosetta: no Apple Silicon build, the x64 one runs on darwin-arm64 with Rosetta 2 (not available on a Mac without it). noArm64: no build runs on Windows ARM64, not even emulated: not available on those kits. targets: the only targets where it is available, empty = all. unavailable: target -> reason (Italian, translated by the catalogs) for the targets with no build: shown instead of installing. remove: other files or folders the component owns (relative to data/apps/<target>, @ = kit root), removed with it unless another installed component lists them too. removeUnix: the same on macOS and Linux, in place of remove when given (their files have other names and places there). sha256ByTarget: SHA-256 fixed per target, with version, where the supplier publishes no hash. check: version command of the final check, program (same rules as key) and arguments. versioned: other minor lines are kept next to the default one in data/apps/<target>/<folder>/<major.minor> and can be chosen for the kit or a project (D-80). group app: part of Dev-Kit itself (the editor), listed with the required ones in Linguaggi e strumenti, checked and locked, always installed at the version and SHA-256 fixed here for this release. desc: Italian, translated by the catalogs.
